item.description: Speaker Ledbetter is an outstanding speaker of the House, and no doubt, Alabama is better thanks to his service.

item.title: Mercedes agrees to post notices about workers’ rights under NLRB settlement
item.description: The settlement comes almost two years after the UAW alleged Mercedes had engaged in illegal unionbusting at its Vance plant.

item.description: Veteran journalist Bill Britt debuted a new podcast to examine the ideas and people influencing Alabama’s political life.

item.title: Opinion | Selma should remind us of the redeeming power of voting
item.description: Nationwide protests against Donald Trump and rightwing extremism have been successful but lacked a clear purpose. Voting should be that purpose.

item.title: Opinion | Alabama GOP resolutions revive the Founders’ warning on factions
item.description: ALGOP resolutions on drag shows, closed primaries, and data centers raise deeper questions about factional power and constitutional liberty.
